videos.title: True Detective

videos.description: Wayne and Roland revisit discrepancies in the Purcell case that were hidden or forgotten, and take another look at Tom Purcell and Lucy's cousin, Dan O'Brien; the glitter of Amelia's book release is tarnished by a voice from the past.

videos.title: True Detective
videos.description: Wayne and Roland track down a man who left the police force in the midst of the Purcell investigation; Amelia visits Lucy Purcell's best friend in hopes of gaining insights into the whereabouts of the mysterious one-eyed man.

videos.title: True Detective
videos.description: Wayne struggles to hold on to his memories, and his grip on reality, as the truth behind the Purcell case is finally revealed.

videos.description: When researchers suddenly disappear, Liz Danvers orders a search but tempers expectations of finding the men; Navarro tries to convince a skeptical Danvers that the men's disappearance is connected to the murder of local activist Annie Kowtok.

videos.description: As Danvers and Prior set out to learn more about Tsalal, and find an unlikely location for the physical evidence, Capt. Connelly threatens to move the case to Anchorage; Navarro and Danvers separately find a connection.

videos.description: While Hank leads the search for Clark, Prior asks Danvers about the murder-suicide case that drove a wedge between her and Navarro; Navarro and Danvers seek out a local hairdresser for insight on Annie.

videos.title: True Detective: Night Country
videos.description: Julia is struggling with mental health problems again; Navarro takes her to a clinic.

videos.description: After Navarro rescues Leah from a volatile Silver Sky protest, Danvers gets a warning against pursuing the Tsalal case any further.

videos.title: True Detective: Night Country
videos.description: As the truth about Tsalal and Annie begins to unfold, Danvers and Navarro each confront the demons from their past.

videos.title: The Hotline
videos.description: An anonymous overdose hotline where people call before using drugs. Volunteers stay on the line, racing against time, creating collective hope amid addiction.

videos.title: The Buffalo Miracle
videos.description: The story of how strangers found sanctuary inside a McDonald's during a blizzard in Buffalo on Christmas Eve.

videos.title: Mass Ave
videos.description: A racial profiling incident forever changes the relationship between a man and his son.

videos.title: The Slightest Touch
videos.description: Emma has spent her life defying expectations; Emma and her longtime friend Colin Farrell embark on the challenge of completing the Dublin Marathon together; after running the full marathon himself, Colin joins Emma for the final four kilometers, pushing her wheelchair one kilometer for each decade that she has lived with EB.

videos.title: Les Misérables
videos.description: After 19 years as a prisoner, Jean Valjean (Hugh Jackman) is freed by Javert (Russell Crowe), the officer in charge of the prison workforce. Valjean promptly breaks parole but later uses money from stolen silver to reinvent himself as a mayor and factory owner. Javert vows to bring Valjean back to prison. Eight years later, Valjean becomes the guardian of a child named Cosette after her mother's (Anne Hathaway) death, but Javert's relentless pursuit means that peace will be a long time coming.

videos.title: The Gilded Age
videos.description: Agnes tries to regain control of the dinner; Peggy's career sparks a conflict with William; Ada meets Dr. Harris.

videos.title: Goodbye Christopher Robin
videos.description: After leaving London for the English countryside, writer A.A. Milne starts to spin fanciful yarns about his son's growing collection of stuffed animals. These stories form the basis for Winnie-the-Pooh and The House at Pooh Corner, published respectively in 1926 and 1928. Milne and his family soon become swept up in the instant success of the books, while the enchanting tales bring hope and comfort to the rest of postwar England.

videos.title: Taking Chance
videos.description: Lt. Col. Michael Strobl, a volunteer military escort accompanies the body of Lance Cpl. Chance Phelps to his hometown in Wyoming.

videos.title: Prime Minister
videos.description: Chronicling Jacinda Ardern's unexpected journey as New Zealand's 40th Prime Minister, this documentary offers an unfiltered window into her years in power.

videos.title: The Lighthouse
videos.description: Two lighthouse keepers try to maintain their sanity while living on a remote and mysterious New England island in the 1890s.

videos.title: Mountainhead
videos.description: Four friends reunite during worldwide economic turmoil.

videos.title: The Post
videos.description: Katharine Graham is the first female publisher of a major American newspaper -- The Washington Post. With help from editor Ben Bradlee, Graham races to catch up with The New York Times to expose a massive cover-up of government secrets that spans three decades and four U.S. presidents. Together, they must overcome their differences as they risk their careers -- and very freedom -- to help bring long-buried truths to light.

videos.title: Dust Bunny
videos.description: Ten-year-old Aurora asks a hit man to kill the monster she believes ate her entire family. To protect her, he'll need to battle an onslaught of assassins while accepting the fact that some monsters are real.

videos.title: Saltburn
videos.description: A student is invited to an eccentric classmate's estate for an exciting summer.

videos.title: Tony
videos.description: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain stumbles into the chaotic world of a Provincetown restaurant kitchen, setting off a summer that will shape the course of his life. Tony captures the sun-soaked feeling of summer in this origin story of the voice that defined a generation. Directed by Matt Johnson and anchored by Dominic Sessa, Antonio Banderas and a rowdy ensemble.

videos.title: Gran Turismo
videos.description: The true story of a team of unlikely underdogs -- a working-class gamer, a former race car driver, and an idealistic motorsport executive -- who risk it all to take on the most elite sport in the world.

videos.title: Pillion
videos.description: A timid man is swept off his feet when an enigmatic, impossibly handsome biker takes him on as his submissive.

videos.title: Aquaman
videos.description: Once home to the most advanced civilization on Earth, the city of Atlantis is now an underwater kingdom ruled by the power-hungry King Orm. With a vast army at his disposal, Orm plans to conquer the remaining oceanic people -- and then the surface world. Standing in his way is Arthur, Orm's half-human, half-Atlantean brother and true heir to the throne. With help from royal counselor Vulko, Arthur must retrieve the legendary Trident of Atlan and embrace his destiny as protector of the deep sea.

videos.title: Aquaman and the Lost Kingdom
videos.description: After failing to defeat Aquaman the first time, Black Manta wields the power of the mythic Black Trident to unleash an ancient and malevolent force. Hoping to end his reign of terror, Aquaman forges an unlikely alliance with his brother, Orm, the former king of Atlantis. Setting aside their differences, they join forces to protect their kingdom and save the world from irreversible destruction.

videos.title: Reframed: Next Gen Narratives
videos.description: Clover must leave her family behind to compete in an algorithm-based singing competition; pressure from the judges leads Clover to doubt herself, but her family's words give her the strength to perform.

videos.title: The Smashing Machine
videos.description: The true story of mixed martial arts and UFC fighter Mark Kerr, whose obsession with greatness made him a legend -- and nearly cost him everything.

videos.title: The Buffalo Miracle
videos.description: The story of how strangers found sanctuary inside a McDonald's during a blizzard in Buffalo on Christmas Eve.

videos.title: The Gilded Age
videos.description: As Bertha's ambition shakes New York society, Agnes plots her comeback; Marian seeks independence and Peggy fights for acceptance from her future in-laws.

videos.title: John Adams
videos.description: After the Boston Massacre, John Adams agrees to serve as defense attorney for the accused British soldiers; several years later, he joins the Continental Congress.

videos.title: John Adams
videos.description: Adams nominates George Washington to lead the newly formed Continental Army; Thomas Jefferson drafts the Declaration of Independence; Congress votes to declare independence from England.

videos.title: John Adams
videos.description: Adams and Jefferson visit France to gain financial and military support for America's Revolutionary War effort; Adams falls victim to an illness.

videos.title: John Adams
videos.description: John and Abigail reunite in Paris; he goes to London as America's first minister to Britain, then must deal with family concerns upon his return to Boston.

videos.title: John Adams
videos.description: Adams becomes the country's first vice president; the ongoing conflict between the British and the French strains Adams' friendship with Jefferson; Adams is elected president in 1796.

videos.description: President Adams tries desperately to keep the nation out of war; Adams disowns his alcoholic son, Charles; Jefferson claims the presidency after Adams fails to win a second term.

videos.title: John Adams
videos.description: While in retirement, Adams begins to write his memoirs, corresponds with Jefferson after a series of personal tragedies, and lives to see his son John Quincy become president.

videos.title: The Regime
videos.description: As Chancellor Elena Vernham prepares for her annual Victory Day celebration, a weary Cpl. Herbert Zubak arrives at the palace, where he's introduced to his new boss's strict health precautions.

videos.title: The Regime
videos.description: Concerned about Zubak's growing influence over Elena, Nicholas conspires with her top ministers in hopes of unearthing damning intel.

videos.title: The Regime
videos.description: After fielding warnings about her new land reforms, Elena orders a controversial military operation and sends Zubak to the front.

videos.title: The Regime
videos.description: As Zubak learns the true location of Keplinger, the chancellor's biggest political rival, Elena attempts to do damage control after a tragic accident; Elena and Nicholas make a rare trip outside palace walls to meet with factory workers.

videos.title: The Regime
videos.description: Elena remains determined not to abandon her people, despite being advised to leave the palace; Schiff, Singer and Huber imagine a scenario where the chancellor could be removed.

videos.title: The Regime
videos.description: With the palace walls now breached, Elena and Zubak find themselves on the run - and seeking help from an everyday citizen - to evade capture by the rebels; Elena leverages her skills in a last-ditch effort to stay in power.
